_doc: The economy mod's match (#524): a stocked economy and a town of wood, planks and stone. Villagers carry and build; only woodcutters and stone cutters, trained at the school, gather, each at its hut. One age; no soldiers.

hunger._doc: every: seconds between meals; eaters: the slots that eat; starving_pct: how much a hungry worker with nowhere to eat works, none after twice every; foods: what a meal is (the mod's hooks/hunger.lua, #47)

gather_ticks._doc: planks are sawn, never gathered; every resource needs a rate

+roster.name: Villager
+roster.desc: Carries goods where they are wanted and builds what you lay out

+roster.name: Woodcutter
+roster.desc: Works at a woodcutter's hut: fells the trees round it and leaves the logs there for the carriers

+roster.name: Stone Cutter
+roster.desc: Works at a quarry: cuts the stone round it and leaves it there for the carriers
